snippet.title: Last Orbit Repairs – Official Trailer | First-Person Robot Repair Sim
snippet.description:
Last Orbit Repairs is a first-person robot repair sim set in the last workshop orbiting a dead Earth.

Robots arrive by service pod with a customer complaint, not a diagnosis. Unbolt the back panel, pull the suspect parts and put them through the bench tester, the Heat Oven, the Load & Vibration Rig and the Dark Box. Then fix what's actually broken, by hand.

▸ Diagnose from the ticket: the complaint points to suspects, the tests name the fault
▸ Repair by hand: brush out fans, spray corroded connectors, reflow solder, replace dried thermal paste, tape frayed cables
▸ Read memory chips and piece together the quiet history of the station
▸ Order tools and machines from the LYN OS terminal, delivered by cargo drone
▸ Build Sekiz, your helper robot, one part at a time
▸ A calm 30-day career from apprentice to master. No timers, no game over.

Steam page coming soon. Subscribe to know when wishlists open.

Platform: Windows (Steam)
Languages: English, Turkish
Developer: Lyn Studio, a solo indie studio from Türkiye

TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@lastorbitrepairs
Discord: https://discord.gg/PQPgGaBVW

—

Last Orbit Repairs, ölü Dünya'nın yörüngesindeki son atölyede geçen birinci şahıs bir robot tamir simülasyonu. Robotlar servis poduyla, teşhisle değil müşteri şikâyetiyle gelir. Kapağı sök, şüpheli parçaları test cihazından ve koşul makinelerinden geçir, gerçekten bozuk olanı elinle onar. Steam sayfası yakında. Oyun Türkçe dil desteğiyle geliyor.

Music and the mechanic's voice in this trailer were created with AI tools.

#LastOrbitRepairs #IndieGame #Simulator
